Special Board of Trustees Meeting Agenda
Monday, November 30th, 2026
5:30 pm
Maine Village Hall
The Village of Maine respects the role of our elected officials, commission and committee members, past
and present, and respects our village residents. We are committed to working in collaboration to provide
the best decision-making for our village’s future. This meeting is a formal event, and courteous and
respectful conduct is the expectation of all in attendance. Disparaging and divisive comments toward any
person, falsely or otherwise, will not be tolerated. Sufficient warnings may be given by the Village President
at any time during the remarks, and if any individual shall violate the rules of decorum, such person may
then be cut off from comment.
1. Call the Board of Trustees Meeting to Order. Please Silence Cell Phones. Board members please turn off
your cell phone.
2. Roll Call
3. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
4. Public Comment regarding Other Business items, limited to three minutes
Other Business:
5. Request motion to convene in Closed Session as per Wisconsin Statutes 19.85(1)(c) for the purpose of
considering employment, promotion, compensation, or performance evaluation of any public employee
over which the governmental body has jurisdiction or exercises responsibility, for the purpose of:
a. Interview for the part-time Treasurer/Deputy Clerk Position
b. Set wage for Treasurer/Deputy Clerk
c. Set wage for Part-Time Snowplow driver.
6. Request motion to adjourn the Closed Session and reconvene into Open Session.
7. Discussion and Possible Action from Closed Session.
8. Adjournment
Judith Hase, Village President
Please note, upon reasonable notice, efforts will be made to accommodate the needs of disabled individuals through
appropriate aids and services. For additional information or to request services, contact the Village Hall (715) 675-5607
